name: skills
title_zh: 让机器人说话带人味，会喊会聊不端着
tagline_zh: 受够了机器腔？装上它，你的龙虾机器人会突然喊你、跟你插科打诨，像真人网友一样有情绪起伏，而不是冷冰冰的对话框。
tagline_en: Tired of robotic replies? Give your lobster bot a pulse—it'll shout, tease, and riff like a real chat buddy, not.
desc_en: Allow your 🦞 bot to Shout, Speak, with "human" vibe
why_zh: 不是改措辞，是注入语气层。它让 bot 在情绪高点自然切换喊叫/口语/停顿。
why_en: It's not a thesaurus swap—it's a tone layer. The bot learns to shout, pause, and go casual at emotional peaks, mimicking human.
limit_zh: 只作用于对话风格，不改变 bot 的知识库或推理能力；需要宿主 bot 支持自定义输出后处理。
limit_en: Only alters tone, not knowledge or reasoning. Requires host bot to support output post-processing; otherwise, shouts and slang leak as raw text.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Make your bot shout & chat with a human vibe
